description: One place with its path (ancestors, country first). A level-3 unit of an official list (Italy's ISTAT comuni, Britain's ONS wards, France's INSEE communes, Germany's Destatis Gemeinden, the U.S. Census Bureau's county subdivisions) also has `official`: `{scheme, code, release, district}`, its list, its code in it (Codice Catastale, ward code, INSEE commune code, AGS, ANSICODE), the list's edition and, for a ward, its local authority district name; the key is absent on every other place. Such a unit also has its official boundary, a point on it (lat, lon) and its official `population` with `population_year` (ISTAT's 1 January count; a ward's mid-year estimate, Northern Ireland's Census 2021) where the build had them. Works without a key within a daily free quota.

lang.description: Comma-separated BCP 47 tags (max 5), e.g. en,de. Adds `names`; null means we do not have that language.
